title: The Blood That Remembers
summary: On the Saint Mirren rooftop under a canopy of stars, Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Captain Baek share an unforgettable farewell banquet, anchoring Ha-Jun's soul with eternal human memories.

panels.shot: the rooftop of saint mirren university under sparkling autumn stars
panels.action: The iconic neoclassical rooftop terrace of Saint Mirren, where Episode 1 began, illuminated by string lanterns under crystal stars.

panels.shot: a picnic table covered with steaming hot korean food
panels.action: A wooden picnic table loaded with steaming tteokbokki, grilled pork belly, fried chicken, and cans of iced soda.

panels.shot: min-jae pouring soda for everyone grinning broadly
panels.action: Min-Jae fills four plastic cups with fizzy cider, laughing: 'The Sovereign demands fried chicken, and Section 9 delivers!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Special delivery from the best BBQ spot in Hongdae!

panels.shot: captain baek in a casual flannel shirt taking a slice of garlic pork
panels.action: General Baek laughs heartily, munching a wrapped lettuce roll: 'Even an army marches on its stomach, boys.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Delicious. Beats military rations any day.

panels.shot: kuro sitting beside the chicken box delicately snatching a drumstick
panels.action: Kuro holds a fried drumstick in his talons, savoring the crispy batter with dignified satisfaction.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The mortal alchemy of seasoned batter is humanity's greatest achievement.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun laughing heartily at kuro antics
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun laugh together, clinking their cups in the crisp evening breeze.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro's true motivation was fried chicken all along.

panels.shot: the conversation settling into comfortable, quiet affection
panels.action: The laughter subsides into peaceful contentment; wind rustles the maple leaves below the balustrade.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at his three companions with eyes full of gratitude
panels.action: Ha-Jun sets down his cup, looking at each of their faces with profound love: 'Thank you for coming tonight.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main aap sabka shukriya ada karna chahta tha.

panels.shot: min-jae sensing the gravity in ha-jun tone leaning forward
panels.action: Min-Jae adjusts his glasses, his smile softening: 'Ha-Jun... What's on your mind? You look like you're going on a long trip.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Is this about the temporal glitches?

panels.shot: ha-jun explaining the tree of origin and his upcoming ascension
panels.action: Ha-Jun calmly explains the universal wound, the choice, and his decision to become the Pillar of Creation.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Universal seam toot rahi hai. To save our world, I must anchor my soul into the Tree of Origin.

panels.shot: min-jae eyes welling with sudden, shocked tears
panels.action: Min-Jae drops his chopsticks, tears spilling down his cheeks: 'Ascend to godhood?! Does that mean... we won't see you anymore?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: You're leaving us?! Just when we finally got peace?!

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching across the table taking min-jae hand gently
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips Min-Jae's trembling hand with warmth: 'No, Min-Jae. I'm not leaving. I'm becoming the roof over your heads.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main kahin nahi ja raha. I will always be watching over you.

panels.shot: min-jae pulling a gift from his backpack: a framed photograph
panels.action: Min-Jae wipes his eyes with his sleeve, pulling out a framed photo of their university graduation day.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Take this with you. So you never forget who you are.

panels.shot: macro on the graduation photo: ha-jun, tae-jun, min-jae, and baek smiling under cherry blossoms
panels.action: The four of them in caps and gowns, laughing under pink cherry blossoms with Kuro perched on Ha-Jun's mortarboard.

panels.shot: ha-jun touching the photo glass with glowing starlight fingertips
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the frame; a tiny spark of starlight preserves the paper so it will never fade across eternity.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This will be the anchor of my soul.

panels.shot: captain baek standing up rendering a solemn military salute
panels.action: General Baek stands at attention, his salute crisp and proud: 'Supreme Sovereign. It has been the honor of my life to serve you.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Humanity will remember your sacrifice for ten thousand generations.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing up and returning the salute with a warm teenage grin
panels.action: Ha-Jun returns the salute with a boyish grin: 'Thank you, General. Keep the peace down here.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Earth ki hifazat aapke haath mein hai, Captain.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up beside ha-jun wrapping his strong arm around him
panels.action: Tae-Jun pulls Ha-Jun into a tight, warm hug: 'I am coming with you to the Origin Gate, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: You aren't walking the final steps alone.

panels.shot: ha-jun resting his cheek against tae-jun shoulder nodding softly
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods: 'I wouldn't have it any other way, Hyung.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Saath mein chalenge.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun shoulder spreading black and violet wings
panels.action: Kuro's feathers blaze with gentle purple starlight: 'The stars have aligned, Ha-Jun. The Tree awaits.'

panels.shot: the four friends joining hands over the center of the picnic table
panels.action: All four companions place their hands one over another in a circle of eternal friendship and brotherhood.

dialogue.text: Four souls bound by fate, forged in fire, sealed in love.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his face to the sky: his eyes glowing with divine starlight
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up; his royal violet eyes reflect the infinite cosmos with fearless love.

panels.shot: a column of pure golden starlight descending from the heavens onto the rooftop
panels.action: A gentle, silent cylinder of warm golden light envelops Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Kuro.

panels.shot: min-jae and baek waving with tears and joyful smiles from the edge
panels.action: Min-Jae and Baek wave through their tears, smiling with pride: 'See you around, Ha-Jun! Visit us for lunch!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: We'll save some chicken for you, brother!!

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing waving back as he begins to levitate into the light
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises weightlessly into the golden beam, waving back with a radiant smile: 'I'll bring the soda next time!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main lunch ke waqt aaunga!

panels.shot: the golden beam carrying the trio into the upper stratosphere
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Kuro ascend through the night clouds, leaving behind a trail of twinkling stardust.

panels.shot: below: the lights of seoul shining like a carpet of warm gold jewels
panels.action: Looking down: the entire city of Seoul glows peacefully, safe and prosperous beneath them.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Look at our home, Hyung. It's so beautiful.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking down with deep peace in his eyes
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles down at the city: 'It's beautiful because you saved it, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ahead: the magnificent gates of the tree of origin opening in space
panels.action: Ahead in the orbit of the Moon, the colossal golden gates of the Tree of Origin swing wide open.
panels.mood: arrival at the gates of eternity

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping through the celestial threshold cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps across the threshold into the heart of creation, ready to claim his True Sovereign Form!

dialogue.text: THE FINAL ASCENSION BEGINS.
